messages:
sophia: Quick sync 12: compact min/max row + burst affordance review. Dropped a small prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/.../minmax-burst-proto. Looking for copy, keyboard flow, and contrast notes. jamal: main concern: the numeric input is visual-only. keyboard users can't tab into the number itself, only the +/- buttons. also SRs might not announce when the value changes. alex: UX question: should burst be a toggle that reveals fields, or a small badge that opens a dedicated panel? toggle keeps the surface tidy but hides configuration. panel keeps settings discoverable. maya: Copy proposal: primary label = 'Burst cap' and helper = 'Temporary capacity above your max for short spikes. Charged at burst rate; auto-reduces.' shorter alt: 'Temporary burst above max (billed).' kevin: Accessibility implementation notes: use role="spinbutton" on the numeric control with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow and keyboard handlers for ArrowUp/ArrowDown/PageUp/PageDown. Example: ```html
2
``` design-bot: Uploaded updated contrast swatches based on AA large text: https://design.internal/redwood/swatches. jamal: Another nit: SLO slider updates cost preview but not announced to screen readers. Add an aria-live region (polite) that reads: 'Estimated cost $X per hour' on change. Also ensure the cost badge has an accessible label with full precision when focused. sophia: Good call. Also noticed min/max labels go faint at 320px; bump tokens or use semibold. We also need distinct focus rings for the spin controls (not just outline none). maya: I changed the tooltip wording in Figma and added a small explainer under the burst badge for first-time users. Tagged @kevin for the spinbutton pattern and @jamal for the live region copy. kevin: I'll prototype keyboard interactions and include a short screencast. Quick copy question: 'burst cap' vs 'burst limit' vs 'burst allowance' 12 my vote: 'burst cap' is clear and aligns with capacity language. alex: Agree with 'burst cap'. One more UX thought: when burst is enabled, show a faint timeline pill that says 'until next scaling window' to set expectations. sophia: Love the timeline pill idea. Action items: @kevin prototype keyboard & aria-live, @jamal draft live region strings, @maya finalize tooltip/copy, I'll open a UX PR once we have the prototype. Thanks! :thumbsup:
